site_visit.headline: See the operation for yourself
site_visit.description: Clients are welcome to arrange a project consultation with our team in Nairobi. Visits can include a discussion of your surveying, civil engineering, equipment, or drone-service requirements.

process_steps.title: Submit a request
process_steps.description: Use the contact form above and select 'Schedule a site visit'. Include your preferred date and project requirements.

process_steps.title: Pre-visit briefing
process_steps.description: Our team will confirm your appointment and share any relevant preparation details.

process_steps.title: Visit our Nairobi office
process_steps.description: Our office is in Nairobi, Kenya. We will share the meeting details when your appointment is confirmed.

process_steps.title: Full site tour
process_steps.description: Meet with our team to discuss your scope, timelines, deliverables, and the most suitable service approach.

process_steps.title: Project next steps
process_steps.description: We will review the recommended next steps, including a tailored scope and quote where applicable.

site_visit.note: Appointments are available Monday–Friday and should be arranged in advance.

items.question: How quickly will you respond to my enquiry?
items.answer: All enquiries submitted through the contact form receive a response from the relevant team member within one business day, Monday–Friday, 08:00–17:00 EAT.

items.question: What information can you provide before a project starts?
items.answer: Smartgrid can provide relevant company information, service details, project experience, and technical documentation on request.

items.question: Can I arrange a consultation before starting a project?
items.answer: Yes. Contact us to arrange a consultation in Nairobi or discuss your requirements remotely.

items.question: Do you work on projects outside Kenya?
items.answer: Yes. Smartgrid provides surveying and engineering services across Kenya and Africa. Contact us with your project location and requirements.

items.question: I represent a fund / family office. Is there a minimum ticket size above $189K?
items.answer: Yes. For large or specialised projects, please contact our team directly at smartgridsurveying@gmail.com to discuss your requirements.
